verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at both docs.superset.sh and superset.sh. The product llms.txt indexes the whole machine-readable surface: agents.md, scoped llms.txt files for docs/api/blog/compare, a docs MCP server, and the OpenAPI spec. Individual doc pages are also served as agent-friendly llms.mdx files, and agents.md is published and quoted, so every element of the story is covered by first-party docs plus hands-on fetch verification.
